mapper.insert: insert into employee(name, dept_id, post_id, level_id, personal_salary, role_id, username, password) values(#{name}, #{deptId}, #{postId}, #{levelId}, #{personalSalary}, #{roleId}, #{username}, #{password})
mapper.update: update employee set name=#{name}, dept_id=#{deptId}, post_id=#{postId}, level_id=#{levelId}, personal_salary=#{personalSalary}, role_id=#{roleId}, username=#{username}, password=#{password} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.post_name AS postName, p.base_salary AS postBaseSalary, l.level_name AS levelName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN role r ON e.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN post p ON e.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN level l ON e.level_id = l.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT e.*, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.post_name AS postName, p.base_salary AS postBaseSalary, l.level_name AS levelName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN role r ON e.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN post p ON e.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN level l ON e.level_id = l.id WHERE e.username = #{username}
